Permutation parameters validation for the runSubtyping function

Source: R/internalValidationFunctions.R
validateRunSubtypingSubSection.Rd

This function validates the permutation parameters for the runSubtyping function. When a parameter is incorrect, a message is sent to the user before quitting the program.

Usage

validateRunSubtypingSubSection(nbAll, permRatio, permNbr, upscaleNbr)

Arguments

nbAll

a integer representing the total number of samples present in the expression matrix.

permRatio

a numeric between 0 and 1 representing the number of samples that are retained for the permutation step. The rounded value of the number of patients multiplied by this numeric should be inferior to the total number of patients so that the permutation step is not done on the entire cohort.

permNbr

a integer bigger than or equal to 5 representing the number of permutation samplings done.

upscaleNbr

a integer, 2 or higher, representing the number of values taken from the normal distribution for each sample to run the upscaling step.

Value

TRUE when all parameters are valid

Author

Astrid Deschênes

Examples


## The function returns TRUE when all parameters are valid
splitTypeR:::validateRunSubtypingSubSection(nbAll=15, permRatio=0.8, 
    permNbr=10, upscaleNbr=10)
#> [1] TRUE
